records.text: The Bible says to forgive as Christ (Jesus Christ) forgave, but Christ (Jesus Christ) doesn't forgive everyone. He forgives those who repent and turn and trust in him by faith. But forgiveness is something that you can't actually offer somebody if they haven't repented. Second Timothy 3, 6 through 7, where Paul (Paul the Apostle) talks about the false teachers who are creeping into households, capturing weak women. Why in that passage?
records.speaker: Alex Clark / Culture Apothecary guest (individual turns unverified)
